name: 80863 · Woodland Park, CO
findings: ZIP 80863 (Woodland Park) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80863 (Woodland Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
